title: Mesoscale polymer regulation for fast-charging solid-state lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3730-3739
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00203F, Paper
Yuetao Ma, Likun Chen, Yuhang Li, Boyu Li, Xufei An, Xing Cheng, Hai Su, Ke Yang, Guanyou Xiao, Yang Zhao, Zhuo Han, Shaoke Guo, Jinshuo Mi, Peiran Shi, Ming Liu, Yan-Bing He, Feiyu Kang
An excellent interfacial compatible PVA coating layer with PVDF facilitates the uniform dispersion of PVA@STO, forming finer spherulites with more interfaces that create Li+ transport pathways for high ionic conductivity.
